verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents team-based collaboration ("Have all your teams in one place and collaborate on your APIs") and enterprise features like SAML SSO and audit logs, implying some access control layer, but there is no explicit documentation of role types (e.g., owner/editor/viewer) or granular per-collection permission settings. missing for 10: explicit role/permission model documentation, evidence of collection/API-level view-vs-edit access control, independent confirmation of RBAC functioning in practice.
